name: Ofshtein Law Firm, P.C.
about: Ofshtein Law Firm is a personal injury practice headquartered on Kings Highway in Brooklyn, and it publishes offices in three states.

It states that it works on a contingency fee with nothing to pay unless the case is won, that the first consultation is free, and that it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes in English, Spanish and Russian.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

G1.evidence: This firm names no attorney on its public pages, so there is no roster whose licensure can be checked. The register is open and free to search; the names are what is missing.

G2.evidence: This firm names no attorney on its public pages, so there is no roster whose disciplinary history can be checked. The register is open and free to search; the names are what is missing.

G3.evidence: OFSHTEIN LAW FIRM, P.C. is an active domestic professional service corporation registered since 2006-11-20, with 1 Google-verified location
G3.source: Active Corporations register (data.ny.gov n9v6-gdp6), published by the New York State Department of State

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 2,659 public client reviews and 20 years since the entity was formed in 2006
G6.source: Google Places API and Active Corporations register (data.ny.gov n9v6-gdp6), published by the New York State Department of State

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the site publishes no case-results page

entity.source: Active Corporations register (data.ny.gov n9v6-gdp6), published by the New York State Department of State

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
